title: What is Health Vibe?
content: Health Vibe is a health and wellness testing platform focused on AI-powered insights, lab testing, personalized recommendations, and digital health records. The website describes its mission as helping users take control of their health through accessible, accurate, and timely diagnostic services.

title: Where should a new user start?
content: If a user is not sure where to start, the homepage encourages them to ask Health Genie for recommendations. Another suggested starting point is the Comprehensive Health Screen, which includes 120 biomarkers and has Male and Female options.

buttons.label: I'm new and need help getting started

title: Main website navigation
content: The main Health Vibe navigation includes Browse All Categories, FDA approved home testing, On demand Virtual Care, Nutritional Support & Supplements, About, Health & Support, Register Kit, and Digital Health Record. The header also includes a search bar for lab tests, login/account area, and cart icon.

title: How Health Vibe works
content: Health Vibe presents a five-step flow: talk to Health Genie about symptoms for AI test recommendations, select tests and add them to cart, choose a service option and checkout, schedule an appointment, then receive lab results and personalized health insights with a health score in 24-48 hours.

title: Health Genie recommendations
content: Health Genie is presented as a personal health guide that helps users get recommendations. The website says users can talk to Health Genie about their symptoms and receive personalized test recommendations.

buttons.label: I'm not sure where to start

title: Comprehensive Health Screen
content: The Comprehensive Health Screen is presented as a default starting option on the homepage. It includes 120 biomarkers and has Male and Female package options.

title: Comprehensive Health Biomarkers - Male
content: The male comprehensive health package includes a broad biomarker panel covering blood type, metabolic markers, liver markers, kidney markers, thyroid markers, lipid markers, inflammation markers, CBC markers, urine markers, vitamins, minerals, biological age, and male hormone/prostate markers. Examples include testosterone total/free/bioavailable, SHBG, free androgen index, PSA total and free, cortisol, insulin, IGF-1, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, zinc, magnesium, iron markers, HbA1c, glucose, cholesterol markers, TSH, T3, T4, creatinine, eGFR, ALT, AST, hs-CRP, homocysteine, and urinalysis markers.

title: Comprehensive Health Biomarkers - Female
content: The female comprehensive health package includes a broad biomarker panel covering blood type, metabolic markers, liver markers, kidney markers, thyroid markers, lipid markers, inflammation markers, CBC markers, urine markers, vitamins, minerals, biological age, and female hormone markers. Examples include estradiol, progesterone, prolactin, estrogen:progesterone ratio, testosterone, FSH, LH, SHBG, cortisol, insulin, IGF-1, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, zinc, magnesium, iron markers, HbA1c, glucose, cholesterol markers, TSH, T3, T4, creatinine, eGFR, ALT, AST, hs-CRP, homocysteine, beta HCG, and urinalysis markers.

title: 6 Months Digital Health Record Included
content: The comprehensive health packages include 6 months of Digital Health Record subscription. The site describes this as a $9.99/month or $99/year value. Included benefits are AI-powered health insights and recommendations, priority access to virtual care consultations, digital health tracking and progress monitoring, and exclusive discounts on future tests.

title: Results and health score
content: After testing, Health Vibe says users can receive lab results and personalized health insights in 24-48 hours. The website also mentions a health score as part of the results experience.

title: Service and checkout options
content: During checkout, users can choose a service option such as a lab visit, home service, or self-collection kit. The website also mentions scheduling a preferred date and time for a lab visit or home service.

title: Health categories and test areas
content: Health Vibe shows health categories including Hormone Health - Male, Hormone Health - Female, Thyroid Health, Vitamin Health, Sexual Health, Metabolic Health, Cardiac Health, Brain Health, Stress & Anti-Ageing, Digestive Health, Bone Health, Gut Health, Nutritional Health, Minerals & Metals, Allergy & Sensitivity Screening, Energy & Exercise Screening, Inflammation Screening, Infection Screening, Immunity Screening, Cancer Screening, and Pharmacogenetic Screening.

title: Hormone Health - Male
content: The Hormone Health - Male category focuses on hormones such as testosterone. The website explains that hormones are messengers that carry signals through the blood. For men, key hormone levels like testosterone decline steadily from the mid-30s. Common symptoms listed include low energy, brain fog, poor sleep, mood swings, hair loss, weight gain, low libido, and muscle loss. Biomarkers shown include total testosterone, SHBG, bioavailable testosterone, free testosterone, free androgen index, testosterone/estradiol ratio, PSA total and free, PSI index, IGF-1, DHT, androstenedione, cortisol, insulin, Vitamin D, and Vitamin B12.

title: Health Intelligence Dashboard
content: The Health Intelligence Dashboard presents health information at a glance with real-time monitoring and AI-powered insights. Example dashboard information includes biomarkers analyzed, biomarkers in range, biomarkers needing attention, biological age, and an action plan with foods, self care, and supplements.

title: About Health Vibe mission and vision
content: Health Vibe's mission is to provide accessible, accurate, and timely diagnostic services that empower individuals to take control of their health and make informed decisions about their wellbeing. Its vision is to revolutionize healthcare diagnostics by combining cutting-edge technology with compassionate care, making quality health testing available to everyone, everywhere.

title: Healthcare impact and experience
content: The About page describes Health Vibe as offering advanced health testing and diagnostics. It lists 15+ years of healthcare excellence, 1250+ tests completed, 150+ health tests available, 5000+ happy patients, and a 98% success rate.

title: Why choose Health Vibe?
content: The About page says Health Vibe combines advanced technology with compassionate care. Reasons listed include trusted and reliable testing, fast results, quality assurance, and expert care from experienced healthcare professionals.

title: Contact and support

title: Trust and certifications
content: Health Vibe shows trust and certification badges including HIPAA Compliant, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, FDA Registered, and CLIA Certified.
